534	and afterward he bakes it

536	the labors of making matzah

538	Rema used the expression "buy wheat and distribute it to the poor."
539	Today, what poor person would agree to take wheat? What would I
540	do with it?
541	No one would take it; rather, one must give them
542	ready matzot, like everyone buys at the store. A poor man is wretched,
543	he has no oven, so give him that. Baruch
544	HaShem, here too, as with everything, it is done
545	publicly. So here too there is a religious council in every place,
546	and it distributes to the poor. We just need to help
547	the religious council that has no money, so that it can buy
548	a lot, according to the needs of the poor of that country,
549	of that city.
550	One must be careful about this.
551	Otherwise, this poor wretch has nothing
552	and nothing to eat, and he will cry out to the Holy One, Blessed
553	Be He, Heaven forbid, for "if he cries out,
554	he will cry out to Me, and I will surely hear" his cry. That is forbidden. So they need
555	in particular at this time a lot of money, of course, since a festival is not
556	only about eating; one must also dress nicely. A man
